fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-03-17 (afternoon, 14:30): The complainant contributed to a local chit group, and after the organiser failed to pay the maturity amount of Rs. 75,000, contact was lost. Lavanya Ammal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000175. A witness, Padmini Raj, reachable on 9000000032, was mentioned in the complaint. A person named Senthil Natarajan, associated with the number 9000000262, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100007 as the destination of the transfer. Madhan Palanisamy (9000000295), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Organiser allegedly stopped payouts and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, associate, afternoon, witness, screenshot, receiving account, main street
